Action: Parse the OddsMarket positions page to extract all open position details.

<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>
curl -s "http://localhost:3003/positions?_autologin=1" | python3 -c "
import sys,re
html=sys.stdin.read()
# find position blocks
blocks=re.split(r'href=\"/positions/', html)

for b in blocks[1:]:
    seg=b[:1500]
    title=re.search(r'>([^<]{10,})</', seg)
    shares=re.search(r'Shares\s*</\w+>\s*<\w+[^>]*>\s*([\d,]+)', seg)
    avg=re.search(r'Avg cost\s*</\w+>\s*<\w+[^>]*>\s*([\d.,¢\$]+)', seg)
    val=re.search(r'Value\s*</\w+>\s*<\w+[^>]*>\s*(\\\$[\d.,]+)', seg)
    pl=re.search(r'P&L\s*</\w+>\s*<\w+[^>]*>\s*([+\-\\\$][\d.,]+)', seg)
    print('---')
    print('title', title.group(1) if title else None)
    print('shares', shares.group(1) if shares else None)
    print('avg', avg.group(1) if avg else None)
    print('val', val.group(1) if val else None)
    print('pl', pl.group(1) if pl else None)
"
